metadata.title: Rentigo - Rent Anything From People Nearby
metadata.description: Peer-to-peer rental marketplace. Rent tools, cameras, sports equipment, and more from people in your neighborhood. Save money, reduce waste, promote sustainability.

footer.tagline: Rent anything from people nearby. Promote reuse, save money, and help the planet.
footer.sustainabilityText: Every rental prevents an unnecessary purchase. Together, we reduce waste and build a more sustainable future through sharing.
footer.copyright: Rentigo. All rights reserved. Built for a sustainable future.

home.heroSubtitle: Why buy when you can rent? Save money, reduce waste, and discover amazing items in your neighborhood.
home.searchPlaceholder: What do you want to rent?
home.step1Desc: Browse thousands of items available for rent in your area. Use filters to find exactly what you need.
home.step2Desc: Reserve your item, pay securely through Stripe, and coordinate with the owner via messaging.
home.step3Desc: Meet the owner, pick up your item, and enjoy! Return it when you're done.
home.sustainText: By renting instead of buying, you help reduce waste, lower carbon emissions, and promote a circular economy. Every item shared is one less item manufactured, packaged, and eventually discarded. Together, we can build a more sustainable future through the power of sharing.
